name: Caterpillar
employees: Approximately 118,000 full-time employees as of 2025-12-31 (51,600 US, 66,400 outside US), per FY2025 Form 10-K. Source: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/CAT/10-k-caterpillar-inc-files-annual-report-fa3bcbb38074.html
revenue: FY2025 sales and revenues USD 67.6 billion (record; Q4 2025 USD 19.1 billion). Power & Energy segment Q4 2025 sales USD 9.4 billion (+23%), segment profit USD 1.841 billion (19.6% margin). Power Generation sales exceeded USD 10 billion in 2025, up more than 30% (CEO, Q4 2025 call). Power & Energy FY2025 revenue reported at USD 28.6 billion, 42% of company revenue (Zacks analysis). Q2 2026 company sales USD 20.5 billion (+24%), Power & Energy USD 8.2 billion (+17%), power generation retail sales +72%. Sources: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/caterpillar-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302673883.html ; https://s25.q4cdn.com/358376879/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/updated/4Q-2025-Caterpillar-Inc-Earnings-Conference-Call_Transcript.pdf ; https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/energy/articles/caterpillars-power-energy-segment-next-172100479.html ; https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/caterpillar-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302841940.html
sector: Construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, electric power generation (diesel and gas generator sets, energy storage, microgrid controls), Cat Financial
positioning_text: Caterpillar is the incumbent premium power generation brand in the Gulf, selling through two long-standing exclusive dealers: Zahid Tractor in Saudi Arabia (Cat dealer since 1950, 22 to 24 branches) and Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar in the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (headquartered in Sharjah, Oman covered through associate Oasis Trading). Its Gulf reach is reinforced by the Zahid Group rental arm Altaaqa, the largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world at over 1 GW, and by Caterpillar's own Middle East Distribution Center, district office and Learning Center in Jebel Ali. Globally, Cat is converting the AI data centre boom into record backlog and is tripling large reciprocating engine capacity to about three times 2024 levels by 2030, which means the 3516E, C175 and G3520K nodes that compete head on with Cummins in the 1.5 to 4 MW band will be more available and more aggressively marketed in the region from 2027.

movements.headline: Zahid Tractor marks 75 years as Caterpillar's Saudi dealer at Jeddah flagship branch
movements.summary: Zahid Tractor and Caterpillar executives, key clients and employees from across the Kingdom gathered at the Jeddah flagship branch to mark 75 years of the dealership, coinciding with Caterpillar's 2025 centennial.

relevance.analysis: The Zahid relationship is the deepest dealer franchise in the Kingdom and is not going to be disrupted. Cummins Arabia should not expect Cat account churn in KSA from dealer instability; wins have to come on product, lead time and service economics.

movements.headline: Joule, Caterpillar and Wheeler agree 4 GW data centre power in Utah on G3520K gensets with 1.1 GWh BESS
movements.summary: Joule Capital Partners, Caterpillar and dealer Wheeler Machinery announced an agreement for 4 GW of total energy for a 4,000 acre data centre campus in central Utah, using G3520K gas gensets with combined cooling heat and power and 1.1 GWh of grid-forming battery storage, launch targeted 2026.

relevance.analysis: This is the template Cat will bring to Gulf data centre developers: gas gensets as prime power plus BESS in one dealer-led package. Cummins Arabia needs an equivalent prime power gas plus storage story for Saudi and UAE campuses before Cat dealers pitch it.

movements.headline: Caterpillar launches Cat D1500 1.5 MW compact diesel genset on C32B engine
movements.summary: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.

relevance.analysis: A 1.5 MW node on a 32 litre engine attacks the footprint and weight argument in the 1,500 to 1,875 kVA class where Cummins sells QSK50 based sets in Saudi 60 Hz projects. Watch for a 50 Hz and Middle East release; until then it is a North America product.

movements.headline: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
movements.summary: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.

relevance.analysis: The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.

movements.headline: Q3 2025: record USD 17.6 billion sales, Energy & Transportation USD 8.4 billion (+17%), backlog USD 39.8 billion led by data centre customers
movements.summary: Caterpillar posted all-time Q3 sales of USD 17.6 billion, Energy & Transportation sales of USD 8.4 billion up 17%, backlog up USD 2.4 billion in the quarter mainly from data centre customers, and full-year tariff cost guidance of USD 1.6 to 1.75 billion.

relevance.analysis: Backlog growth driven by data centres means Cat factory slots are being consumed by US hyperscalers. In the near term this leaves room for Cummins Arabia on lead time in the Gulf; the window narrows as Cat capacity comes online.

movements.headline: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar exhibit together at ADIPEC 2025 in Abu Dhabi
movements.summary: Al-Bahar and Caterpillar shared stand 9430 at ADIPEC 2025 (3 to 6 November, ADNEC), showcasing high-efficiency engines, rebuild programmes and data-driven lifecycle solutions for oil and gas customers.

relevance.analysis: Cat is keeping its oil and gas power and marine franchise warm with ADNOC-ecosystem buyers through the dealer. Cummins Arabia should track ADNOC and Lamprell type accounts where Al-Bahar has installed 3500 series sets and target the rebuild and CVA renewal cycle.

movements.headline: Zahid Tractor runs 2026 Sales Campus with Caterpillar management at Zahid Business Park
movements.summary: Three-day Sales Campus (13 to 15 January 2026) for the full Zahid sales organisation, product support, SMD and Ejar rental divisions with Caterpillar management and instructors, built around a customer-back approach, VisionLink, Cat Inspect and uptime guarantees.

relevance.analysis: Zahid is standardising a digital, uptime-guarantee sales motion across machines, power and rental in the Kingdom. Cummins Arabia should expect connected-asset and uptime-guarantee terms to appear in Saudi genset bids and should have PowerCommand Cloud and service-level commitments ready as standard.

movements.headline: AIP Corp, Caterpillar and Boyd CAT form alliance for 2 GW of G3516 gas gensets plus BESS at Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned
movements.summary: American Intelligence & Power Corp announced 2 GW of fast-response Cat G3516 natural gas gensets with battery storage and SCR for a West Virginia AI campus, deliveries September 2026 to August 2027, 2 GW online 2027, 8 GW planned in total.

relevance.analysis: Cat's G3516 is being positioned as prime power infrastructure, not standby. If Gulf hyperscale developers such as those building for Humain or Khazna adopt behind-the-meter gas, Cat arrives with a referenceable multi-GW installed base. Cummins Arabia should build its own gas prime power references now.

movements.headline: FY2025 results: Power Generation above USD 10 billion (+30%), Q4 power generation +44%, Middle East called out as strong, 2026 tariff cost USD 2.6 billion, price realisation about +2%
movements.summary: Q4 2025 Power & Energy sales USD 9.4 billion (+23%), profit USD 1.841 billion; CEO said Power Generation exceeded USD 10 billion in 2025 with growth above 30% and that the Middle East continues to be really strong; 2026 tariff cost guided at about USD 2.6 billion with roughly 2% favourable price realisation for the year.

relevance.analysis: Cat leadership sees the Middle East as a strong market entering 2026 and is pushing price up about 2% while absorbing tariffs. Cummins Arabia has a pricing window on US-built product costs; it should quantify landed cost differences per node and sell that to Saudi and UAE buyers before Cat mitigates.

movements.headline: Caterpillar, OnePWR Solutions and Vero3 collaborate on 500 MW gas power with carbon capture for data centres
movements.summary: Caterpillar supplies generation and leads front-end engineering for carbon capture, OnePWR builds, owns and operates, Vero3 handles CO2 storage; inaugural project targets 500 MW of prime power launching in 2026.

relevance.analysis: Gas plus carbon capture is a decarbonisation answer Gulf regulators and NEOM-type clients will ask for. Cummins Arabia has no equivalent bundled offer; it should decide whether to partner for capture or lean on HVO and hydrogen-ready messaging.

movements.headline: PROPWR signs framework with Caterpillar for at least 1.5 GW of gas generation assets, option to about 2.1 GW
movements.summary: ProPetro's PROPWR division agreed to buy at least 1.5 GW of Caterpillar power generation assets over five years with an option to about 2.1 GW, for about 2.6 GW operating by end 2031 including 550 MW already ordered, serving data centres, oil and gas and industry.

relevance.analysis: Cat is locking multi-year framework volume with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf equivalents (Altaaqa, Aggreko type players and Saudi IPP developers) are the accounts where Cummins Arabia should propose its own multi-year fleet frameworks before Cat dealers do.

movements.headline: Q1 2026: Caterpillar triples large reciprocating engine capacity plan to about 3x 2024 levels, adds about 15 GW per year, power generation +48%
movements.summary: Q1 2026 sales USD 17.4 billion (+22%), Power & Energy USD 7 billion (+22%), power generation sales +48%; large engine capacity plan raised from 2x to nearly 3x 2024 levels with investment mainly 2027 to 2029, about 15 GW of additional annual capacity; large engine backlog up 3.5x since January 2024; tariff cost guidance cut to USD 2.2 to 2.4 billion; six agreements of at least 1 GW each announced; EAME outlook noted softening anticipated in the Middle East.

relevance.analysis: This is the structural threat. By 2028 Cat will have far more 3500, C175 and G3500 engine supply than today and will need non-US outlets for it, and the Gulf is the obvious one. Cummins Arabia should lock multi-year supply agreements and service contracts with key Saudi and UAE accounts in 2026 and 2027 while Cat is still capacity constrained.

movements.headline: Zahid Tractor publishes updated Saudi branch map (22 to 24 branches) and a 75 years of partnership campaign

relevance.analysis: Zahid's network already covers every Saudi industrial cluster including the northern and southern regions where Cummins Arabia has thinner coverage. Any Cummins Arabia branch plan should be checked against this map to avoid opening where Cat service is already dense and to prioritise gaps.

movements.headline: US state data centre moratoria (New York EO 62, New Jersey cost-sharing law) trigger Baird downgrade, CAT falls over 6%
movements.summary: New York signed a moratorium on hyperscale data centres above 50 MW pending review and New Jersey passed a cost-sharing law; at least 12 states have moratorium bills; Baird downgraded Caterpillar citing regulatory risk to power generator demand.

relevance.analysis: If US data centre permitting slows, Cat will redirect gensets and sales focus to the Gulf where Saudi and UAE AI campuses face no such moratoria. That raises competitive intensity in KSA and UAE from late 2026. Cummins Arabia should assume more aggressive Cat dealer pricing on large nodes.

movements.headline: Q2 2026: first USD 20 billion quarter, power generation +72%, backlog USD 72 billion, 10 MW medium-speed gas engine production restarted for 1.5 GW
movements.summary: Sales USD 20.5 billion (+24%), Power & Energy USD 8.2 billion (+17%) with 24.6% margin, power generation retail sales +72% on large gensets and turbines for data centres, backlog USD 72 billion (+92%), 2026 guidance raised to mid to high teens growth, USD 392 million IEEPA tariff recovery booked, and production of a 10 MW medium-speed gas engine restarted with shipments from Q4 2026 targeting 1.5 GW.

relevance.analysis: The 10 MW medium-speed gas platform fills the gap between Cat high-speed gensets and Solar turbines, directly bracketing Cummins HSK78G and QSK95 gas offers for Gulf industrial and utility prime power. Cummins Arabia should expect Cat to bid gas plants at 10 to 100 MW in Saudi and Kuwait with a single-OEM stack by 2027.

movements.headline: Stella Power orders large quantity of Solar Turbines Titan 130 packages for data centre and industrial onsite power
movements.summary: Stella Power Company placed a large order for PGM130 packages (Titan 130 gas turbine, over 16 MW each, 90 second start, 2 ppm NOx capable) from Caterpillar's Solar Turbines for onsite power at data centres, industrial sites and oil and gas in North America.

relevance.analysis: Cat can offer turbines above the reciprocating band, so in Gulf prime power tenders above 20 MW it can shift the buyer from gensets to turbines. Cummins Arabia should hold the reciprocating advantages (part-load efficiency, modular redundancy, N+1 flexibility) in its bid narrative.

movements.headline: Energy Vault signs 1.25 GW integrated power deal in Texas for a hyperscaler with an EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets
movements.summary: Energy Vault's largest contract to date: 1.25 GW of integrated power infrastructure in Texas for an AI data centre, with a power generation EPC deploying Caterpillar gensets and Energy Vault grid-forming BESS, initial deployments within 4 to 12 months.

relevance.analysis: Third-party BESS integrators are packaging Cat gensets by default. In the Gulf, Cummins Arabia should court the BESS integrators and EPCs (not just end users) so that Cummins is the default genset in their bills of material.

partnerships.partner: Zahid Tractor & Heavy Machinery Co. Ltd. (Zahid Group)
partnerships.scope: Sole Cat dealer for Saudi Arabia covering machines, engines, electric power, marine, oil and gas and Cat mining; 22 to 24 branches; engine rebuild centres Jeddah and Dammam; embedded site technicians on strategic projects

why_it_matters.analysis: Seventy-five years of relationships with Aramco, SEC, giga-project developers and contractors give Cat first call on Saudi power tenders. Cummins Arabia competes against a dealer with more service points than it has; the counter is faster quotes, guaranteed lead times and total cost of ownership at the node level.

partnerships.scope: Cat dealer for UAE, Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain (Oman via associate Oasis Trading); power systems sales, packaging, rental power with nine regional depots, CVAs, switchgear, UPS, ATS and load banks

why_it_matters.analysis: Al-Bahar is the direct competitor to Cummins Arabia in UAE and Kuwait for every hospital, metro, oil and gas and data centre standby package. Its rental fleet lets it seed accounts with temporary power and convert to permanent Cat sets, a motion Cummins Arabia should match with its own rental partners.

partnerships.scope: Largest single owner of Cat rental generators in the world, over 1 GW, 62 kVA to 2,000 kVA, six depots plus 17 Zahid branches, turnkey rental power plants for oil and gas, mining, cities and remote sites

why_it_matters.analysis: Every MW Altaaqa deploys is a Cat MW and often becomes a permanent Cat sale. Cummins Arabia should target the rental buyers who want a second OEM for fleet resilience and price competition, and should protect its own rental partner relationships in KSA.

partnerships.scope: Caterpillar International Power Projects partner for 20 to 100+ MW temporary power plants across Africa, Middle East, Latin America and Asia, Dubai based

why_it_matters.analysis: Gives Cat a utility-scale temporary power channel that Cummins Arabia does not have in the Gulf. Relevant when Kuwait MEW or Saudi utilities seek bridging power; Cummins Arabia should partner with an IPP-style rental operator for those tenders.

partnerships.scope: Cat Rental Store franchise in Saudi Arabia with mobile generator sets among rental lines; locations include Makkah and Dammam; part of Zahid's 2026 Sales Campus organisation

why_it_matters.analysis: Small and mid-size rental gensets feed contractor relationships that later specify permanent standby sets. Cummins Arabia should ensure its C-series and QSK rental units are positioned with Saudi contractors through its own rental channel.

partnerships.partner: Red Sea Global (The Red Sea Project)
partnerships.scope: 69 Cat gensets, 32 MW prime power, B100 biodiesel capable, Cat Connect remote monitoring and CVAs supplied by Zahid Tractor for construction phase power

why_it_matters.analysis: Cat holds the incumbent position on the Red Sea giga-project and its renewable fuel narrative. For permanent power phases (hotels, airport), Cummins Arabia should bid with HVO-compatible sets and hybrid microgrid options before the incumbent locks the follow-on.

partnerships.scope: About 5,000 Cat machines on site with CVAs, technician training and 24/7 support through Zahid Tractor; power generation scope not stated

why_it_matters.analysis: Zahid's machine footprint at NEOM gives it daily access to NEOM procurement. Cummins Arabia should not assume genset packages at NEOM are open competitions; it needs early engagement with NEOM's energy and data centre teams.

partnerships.scope: 6 MW hybrid microgrid in Sharjah: 2.7 MW Cat PV, five Cat 3412 gensets (3.24 MW), Cat ESS 286 kWh/250 kW, Cat Master Microgrid Controller; 2020 follow-on with 3516E 50 Hz and 60 Hz HV ratings

why_it_matters.analysis: Al-Bahar has a live UAE reference for single-supplier solar, genset and storage integration. Cummins Arabia should have a comparable hybrid reference in UAE or KSA to avoid losing agri, industrial and remote-site microgrid tenders on integration credibility.

partnerships.scope: Five Cat 3516C (1530 ekW, 60 Hz, 600 V) and one 3512C (1310 ekW) for the first of two LeTourneau Super 116E jack-up rigs, commissioned by Al-Bahar 2022-11

why_it_matters.analysis: Cat owns the UAE offshore rig power niche through Al-Bahar. Cummins Arabia's marine and drilling engines could target the second rig and future ADNOC Drilling newbuilds if it can show class approvals and local commissioning capacity.

partnerships.partner: Dubai Roads and Transport Authority (Dubai Metro)
partnerships.scope: 20 Cat gensets (8 x 3516, 8 x 3512, 2 x C18, 2 x C15, 50 Hz, 320 to 1,820 kW) for emergency backup, with installation, training and three-year maintenance contract via Al-Bahar

why_it_matters.analysis: The Dubai Metro fleet is now 15 years old and approaching replacement or major overhaul cycles. Cummins Arabia should position for RTA replacement and Route 2020 extension standby packages where an incumbent-only assumption may be weak.

partnerships.partner: American Intelligence & Power Corp and Boyd CAT
partnerships.scope: 2 GW of G3516 fast-response gas gensets plus BESS and SCR for the Monarch Compute Campus, 8 GW planned, deliveries 2026-09 to 2027-08

why_it_matters.analysis: Establishes Cat gas gensets as prime power for AI campuses at multi-GW scale. Gulf hyperscale developers will benchmark against this. Cummins Arabia needs a documented gas prime power reference and a partner BESS to stay on shortlists.

partnerships.partner: Joule Capital Partners and Wheeler Machinery
partnerships.scope: 4 GW data centre campus power in Utah on G3520K gensets with CCHP and 1.1 GWh grid-forming BESS, launch targeted 2026

why_it_matters.analysis: Confirms the G3520K as Cat's flagship data centre prime power node. Cummins Arabia should prepare a node-by-node comparison of HSK78G against G3520K on efficiency, start time and footprint for Gulf ambient conditions.

partnerships.scope: Framework for at least 1.5 GW, option to about 2.1 GW, of Cat gas generation assets over five years for data centres, oil and gas and industry

why_it_matters.analysis: Shows Cat's willingness to sign multi-year volume frameworks with power-as-a-service operators. Gulf oilfield service and rental operators are the analogue; Cummins Arabia should offer framework pricing and priority allocation to lock them first.

partnerships.scope: Gas generation plus carbon capture, BESS and permanent CO2 sequestration for data centres; inaugural 500 MW prime power project launching 2026

why_it_matters.analysis: Gas with capture is a credible answer to Gulf sustainability procurement criteria. Cummins Arabia should decide on a capture or offset partner or risk being screened out on carbon in NEOM and UAE net-zero aligned campuses.

gulf_reference_projects.project: The Red Sea Project construction power (Red Sea Global)
gulf_reference_projects.summary: Zahid Tractor supplied 69 Cat gensets able to run on diesel or B100 biodiesel with Cat Connect remote monitoring and CVAs for the regenerative tourism giga-project on the west coast.
Zahid Tractor supports about 5,000 Cat machines at NEOM with CVAs, technician training and 24/7 field support; expected to double over the following year. No genset scope stated.

gulf_reference_projects.project: Aramco Tanajib Gas Plant temporary power
gulf_reference_projects.summary: Altaaqa (Zahid Group, Cat rental fleet owner) delivered temporary power for pumps and security offices at 460 V and 380 V with a 50 kVA transformer and LV panel; genset brand not named in the article.

gulf_reference_projects.project: Themar Al Emarat greenhouse hybrid power, Sharjah
gulf_reference_projects.capacity: 5.94 MW hybrid; earlier 6 MW microgrid (2.7 MW PV, 3.24 MW gensets, 286 kWh ESS)
gulf_reference_projects.summary: Al-Bahar delivered a single-supplier microgrid with Cat PV, five 3412 gensets, Cat ESS and Master Microgrid Controller, followed by 3516E high-voltage 50 Hz and 60 Hz ratings for the 5.94 MW hybrid.
Al-Bahar commissioned the integrated Cat power package on the first of two rigs; order placed January 2020, second rig in development.

gulf_reference_projects.project: COVID-19 emergency power, Abu Dhabi and Kuwait
gulf_reference_projects.capacity: 17 MW rental (10 x C15 500 kVA, 4 x C32 1,000 kVA, 8 x 3512 1,500 kVA) plus C13 sets
gulf_reference_projects.summary: Al-Bahar deployed 17 MW of rental power to two quarantine facilities 100 km outside Abu Dhabi, C13 gensets with ATS to five drive-through test centres, and two C18 plus one C13 to Kuwaiti Army field clinics.
Al-Bahar supplied, installed and commissioned 50 Hz Cat gensets for Phases 1 and 2 with staff training and a three-year maintenance contract.

gulf_reference_projects.project: Caterpillar Dubai District Office solar plant
gulf_reference_projects.summary: Al-Bahar installed a grid-tied PV plant at the Caterpillar district office in Jafza, the first solar ground installation in Jafza for a training centre.

gulf_reference_projects.project: Cat C18 706 to 850 kVA 50 Hz launch across UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and Qatar
gulf_reference_projects.summary: Al-Bahar introduced the uprated C18 genset across its five territories, citing reduced installation cost and lower fuel consumption (VP Energy & Transportation Mohamed El Kaddour).
